LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.CatalogMissingDefs: No glyph defs were loaded. Check that the spellbook XML is active.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.ChainEmpty: Click a glyph on the left page to put it in the spell bar.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.ChainHint: Click a left-page glyph to add it; click a glyph in the bar to remove it.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.NoSelection: Hover a glyph in the catalogue or in the bar to read it here. Click a catalogue glyph to add it; click a glyph in the bar to remove it.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.TimingTip: Cast time that Create freezes into the slot: windup {0} ticks, channel {1} ticks, recovery {2} ticks (60 ticks = 1 second). Every glyph adds its own share. The caster may walk during windup, is slowed while channelling and stands still during recovery.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.ValidationOk: The combination is valid and can be created.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.CastReady: Current slot {0} is ready to cast.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.CastNoSaved: Current slot {0} is empty. Create a spell first.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.EmptySlotHint: The current slot is empty: compose a spell and press Create so the pawn's cast button has something to fire.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.CreateTip: Write the spell bar into the current slot {0}; an existing spell is overwritten without asking.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.Created: Created in slot {0} and set as the active spell.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.BarEmpty: The spell bar is empty. Add glyphs from the left page first.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.ClearBarTip: Clears the spell bar only; the spell saved in the current slot stays.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.BarCleared: Spell bar cleared; the saved spell did not change.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.DeleteSlotTip: One click deletes the spell in slot {0}; there is no confirmation.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.CastTip: Start target selection with the spell created in current slot {0}.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.SwitchBookmark: Click to switch bookmark: it becomes the current slot at once and the pawn's cast button follows
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.StatusReady: Click glyphs to fill the bar; only Create writes it into the current slot. Uncreated edits are dropped on a slot switch or when the book closes.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.NoGameComponent: The save component is not ready, so slots cannot be read or written yet.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.AnimTip: Turns the page animations on or off. Interaction is identical, only the fly-in, page band, shake and sweep stop playing.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook.LabOpenTip: Open the spellbook for the selected pawn: compose glyphs, create them into a bookmark and pick the spell they cast.
